descriptions.text: The main checkout path. Owned by the checkout team. Do not change the OrderPlaced payload without telling analytics and shipping.

A customer places an order through the public API. The gateway hands it to orders-svc, which checks it, reserves stock and takes payment, then stores the order and announces OrderPlaced. Shipping, inventory and analytics react to that event on their own.

Why it exists: turn a checkout click into a paid, stock-backed order, and keep slow follow-up work (shipments, emails) out of the customer's wait.
Accepts the order from the gateway, checks it, reserves stock and takes payment, then stores it and publishes OrderPlaced for the rest of the system.
Creates the shipment record for a placed order and asks notifications to email the customer. Written before the flow was changed, so it may no longer be right.
Deletes an order by id. Written from an earlier version of the flow; regenerate it to match what the flow does now.
